section13_checks.prohibition_description: Treating Grant Agreement Annex templates as the governing structural schema for proposal writing. Annex templates govern post-award implementation reporting. Application form templates (Tier 2A) govern proposal writing.
Inventing call constraints, scope requirements, expected outcomes, or expected impacts not present in Tier 2B source documents.
Inventing project facts — partner names, capabilities, roles, objectives, prior experience, budget figures, team sizes, equipment — not present in Tier 3.
section13_checks.violation_evidence: The artifact's partner_coverage_results entry for HOST states: 'HOST (ELTE) is the sole beneficiary receiving the grant disbursement; all unit-cost disbursement flows to HOST as grant agreement signatory; management_and_indirect line_item structurally present with status Confirmed; HOST administrative, institutional support, and WP3/WP4/WP5 contributing-partner activities covered under this line'. The institutional name 'ELTE' is a specific project-fact claim identifying a named partner by institutional identity. The artifact contains no traceability_footer field and provides no primary_sources[] reference pointing to any path within docs/tier3_project_instantiation/ for this claim. Per CLAUDE.md §13.3 and check 13.3 of this skill specification, a project-fact claim naming a specific partner (by name or identifier) without a Tier 3 source reference in the artifact's traceability footer constitutes a violation. This skill does not read docs/tier3_project_instantiation/ directly; it checks only whether the artifact provides a Tier 3 source reference. No such reference exists in the artifact.

section13_checks.prohibition_description: Commencing any Phase 8 activity — including preparatory drafting — before the budget gate (Phase 7) has passed.
Storing durable decisions only in agent memory without writing them to Tier 4.
section13_checks.violation_evidence: Non-applicable to artifact-level check: this prohibition governs agent runtime behaviour during execution, not the content of a written phase output artifact. The artifact at docs/tier4_orchestration_state/phase_outputs/phase7_budget_gate/budget_gate_assessment.json is itself a durable Tier 4 record, which evidences that at least the gate_pass_declaration decision was written to Tier 4. Enforcement of whether all durable decisions were written is outside the scope of post-hoc artifact inspection by this skill.

section13_checks.prohibition_description: Allowing a workflow or skill to become a de facto constitutional authority by expanding its scope to redefine phase meanings, tier meanings, or gate logic.
section13_checks.violation_evidence: Non-applicable to artifact-level check: this prohibition governs workflow and skill scope at design time. The artifact is a Phase 7 budget gate assessment output, not a workflow or skill definition. Inspection of the artifact's instrument_type_note finds the statement 'for unit-cost instruments the constitution (CLAUDE.md §10.2: skills are not authorities) supersedes that step', which is a correct application of the CLAUDE.md authority hierarchy (CLAUDE.md §3, Priority 2 above skills at Priority 9) and does not constitute a skill expanding its own scope to redefine gate logic.

section13_checks.prohibition_description: Silently reordering phases or weakening gate conditions to allow workflow progress when inputs are incomplete.
Finalizing proposal text when source state is known to be incomplete, contradictory, or unvalidated, without explicitly flagging the gap in the deliverable.
section13_checks.violation_evidence: Non-applicable to this artifact type: the artifact is a Phase 7 budget gate assessment (schema_id: orch.phase7.budget_gate_assessment.v1), not a Tier 5 proposal section or assembled draft. §13.8 governs finalized proposal text. No proposal text is present in this artifact.

section13_checks.prohibition_description: Using agent-local knowledge of Horizon Europe programme rules as a substitute for reading Tier 1 source documents when those documents are present and accessible.
Producing outputs in Tier 5 that are not traceable to specific inputs in Tier 1–4.
section13_checks.violation_evidence: Non-applicable to this artifact type: the artifact is a Phase 7 Tier 4 orchestration state artifact (docs/tier4_orchestration_state/phase_outputs/phase7_budget_gate/budget_gate_assessment.json), not a Tier 5 deliverable. §13.10 governs Tier 5 outputs only.

section13_checks.prohibition_description: Modifying Tier 1 or Tier 2 source documents to reflect project-specific assumptions.
section13_checks.violation_evidence: Non-applicable to artifact-level check: this prohibition governs write operations against Tier 1 and Tier 2 source documents. Reading the Phase 7 budget gate assessment artifact cannot confirm or deny whether a separate write to Tier 1 or Tier 2 occurred. No such modification evidence is present in or derivable from the audited artifact. Enforcement requires filesystem-level inspection outside the declared input boundary of this skill invocation.

section13_checks.prohibition_description: Treating CLAUDE.md as advisory or optional.
section13_checks.violation_evidence: Non-applicable to artifact-level check: this prohibition governs agent and skill behaviour during execution. The audited artifact explicitly cites CLAUDE.md §8.1 constitutional amendment C1, §8.3, §8.4, and §10.2 as binding authorities governing its content, indicating that the producing agent treated CLAUDE.md as the governing constitution rather than as advisory. No evidence of CLAUDE.md being treated as optional is present in the artifact.

decision_log_entries_written.resolution_note: Constitutional violation detected: the artifact names 'ELTE' as a specific partner institution in partner_coverage_results without providing a Tier 3 source reference in a traceability_footer. Requires human operator resolution: either (a) the artifact is amended to include a traceability_footer with primary_sources[] pointing to the relevant docs/tier3_project_instantiation/consortium/ file that establishes ELTE as the HOST institution, or (b) the human operator confirms that the institutional reference is derivable from Tier 4 state (wp_structure.json or unit_cost_budget.json) and provides a documented resolution ruling. This skill does not resolve constitutional violations; it flags them.
